title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Ranking & Recommendations
text:
About Fernwood Labs
Fernwood Labs powers discovery for over 30 million monthly active buyers across our curated home, apparel, and artisan marketplace. Every search query, homepage feed, and related-item carousel is backed by real-time machine learning systems that balance relevance, novelty, and seller fairness.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Core Ranking & Recommendations team. You will own end-to-end modeling and serving infrastructure—from candidate generation and multi-stage scoring to online experimentation—directly shaping how millions of shoppers discover products every day.

What You Will Do
- Design, train, and deploy deep learning models for personalized homepage recommendations, search ranking, and sponsored click-through-rate (CTR) prediction.
- Build and operate online feature stores backed by low-latency key-value storage and streaming ingestion to serve fresh real-time user and item signals.
- Partner with infrastructure engineers to meet strict real-time serving SLAs (sub-50ms p99 latency at tens of thousands of queries per second).
- Scale Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) vector retrieval pipelines across tens of millions of catalog embeddings.
- Design and analyze controlled online experiments, defining guardrail metrics and applying variance reduction techniques to measure long-term marketplace impact.
- Mentor junior engineers and lead technical design reviews across the personalization organization.

Requirements (Must-Haves)
- 4+ years of experience building and deploying production machine learning models in Python and PyTorch.
- Hands-on experience with personalized recommendation, search ranking, or ads click-through-rate (CTR) prediction systems.
- Experience building or operating online feature stores (e.g., Feast, Tecton) backed by low-latency key-value storage.
- Track record of meeting strict real-time serving SLAs (sub-50ms p99 latency at high throughput).
- Proficiency designing and analyzing controlled online experiments, including guardrail metrics and variance reduction.
- Experience with Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) vector retrieval at scale.
- Ability to build distributed data and training pipelines using Apache Spark on Google Cloud Platform.

Nice-to-Haves
- Experience mentoring junior engineers and leading technical design reviews.
- Experience writing custom C++ or CUDA kernels for model inference acceleration.
- Hands-on experience with LLM-based semantic reranking or LoRA fine-tuning for generative retrieval.
